newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina rises in weak Milan on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Gemina rises in weak Milan on H1 results.

text.p: Italian financial holding group Gemina rose on a weaker Milan bourse after reporting first half results showing a return to profit, dealers said.
At 0850 GMT, Gemina shares were 3.41 percent up at 680 lire after an early high at 689.
Gemina on Tuesday night said it posted first half 1996 consolidated net profit of 115.1 billion lire against a first half 1995 loss of 409.2 billion lire.
"These results appear to close a negative period for the group," one trader said.
The all-share Mibtel indeds was off 0.93 percent at 9,498.
